name: Weighted Single-Arm Pull-Up
steps: Take an overhand grip with one hand and hold a plate at your side with the free hand.
Lift your feet clear and settle into a straight-arm hang with your abdomen braced and the plate still.
Pull forcefully upward through your working lat and arm until your chin clears the bar.
Lower to a controlled hang, stand and set down the plate before switching arms.
tips: Use strict control throughout the lowering phase to protect your working shoulder and elbow.
Initiate every repetition by setting your shoulder blade down before pulling with your arm.
